Metadata.title: MaskinGo
Metadata.description: Plan jobs, assign driver and machine, log hours from the phone and create an invoice draft the same day. Built for Norwegian truck, crane and machine contractors.
Metadata.homeTitle: MaskinGo · Jobs, hours and invoices for machine contractors
Metadata.ogAlt: MaskinGo: from phone call to invoice the same day

Home.badge: For truck, crane and machine contractors
Home.title: From phone call to invoice the same day
Home.lead: MaskinGo replaces phone, text messages and Excel for truck, crane and machine contractors: the job, the driver, the hours worked and the invoice in one place.

receive.title: Plan
receive.body: Enter the job and assign a truck or machine and a driver in the calendar.

check.title: Work
check.body: The driver taps On the way, Arrived and Finished. The hours are recorded from those taps.

approve.title: Invoice
approve.body: The invoice is made from approved hours and sent as a PDF by e-mail when you press Send. Nothing is sent automatically.

jobs.title: Jobs and calendar
jobs.body: Every job with customer, address, machine and driver. Day and week views show who is free.

driver.title: Driver app on the phone
driver.body: Drivers see only their own jobs, tap On the way, Arrived and Finished, and add photos and the customer’s signature.

hours.title: Hours without timesheets
hours.body: Working time is recorded from the taps. The office can correct it before the hours are approved.

customers.title: Customers and prices
customers.body: Customer register with org. number and custom hourly rates per machine. Minimum time per machine is applied automatically.

invoices.title: Invoices with PDF
invoices.body: Sequential invoice numbers, a PDF and e-mail delivery to the customer.

team.title: Team and roles
team.body: Admin, dispatcher, driver and accountant each see only what they need.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: This page explains which personal data MaskinGo processes, why, and what rights you have.

sections.title: Who is responsible
body: {company} (org. no. {orgNumber}), {address}, is the controller for data about user accounts and visitors to maskingo.no.
Send privacy questions to {email}.

sections.title: Data a company enters
body: A company using MaskinGo enters data about its customers, employees and jobs. The company is the controller for that data, and {company} is its processor under the data processing agreement. We use it only to provide the service to the company.
To see, correct or delete such data, contact the company that entered it.

sections.title: What data we process
body: Account: name, e-mail address, language, role and which company you belong to. The password is stored only as a cryptographic hash.
Company: name, organisation number and invoice details.
Sign-in: for owners and admins we store the time and browser type of the extra sign-in step by e-mail.
Jobs: times from the On the way, Arrived and Finished taps, and uploaded photos and signatures. We do not collect location (GPS).
Invoices: the content of invoices and who they were e-mailed to.
Subscription: chosen plan, trial and payment status. Card details go straight to Stripe; we never see them.
Operations: our providers log IP address and time to keep the service secure and running.

sections.title: Purpose and legal basis
body: We process the data to provide the service under the agreement with you or your company (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b)).
Security logs and protection against abuse rely on our legitimate interest in a secure service (Art. 6(1)(f)).
We do not use the data for marketing, do not sell it and do not use it to train artificial intelligence.

sections.title: Who sees the data
body: Other users in the same company see your name and what their role gives access to. Users in other companies see none of it.
Our providers process the data on our behalf, see the next section. Otherwise we disclose data only when the law requires it.

sections.title: Providers
body: Supabase: database, sign-in and files. Stored in Stockholm, Sweden.
Vercel: runs the website. Server functions run in Stockholm, Sweden.
Resend: sends e-mail, in its EU region.
Stripe: card payments for the subscription, and receipts.

All four are US companies. The data is stored in the EU/EEA, but a provider may in some cases access it from the US. Such transfers rely on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses or the EU–US Data Privacy Framework.

sections.title: How long we keep data
body: Account data is kept for as long as the account exists. If you ask for deletion, we delete the account within 30 days.

Invoices a company issues in MaskinGo cannot be deleted while the company uses the service. The company itself is responsible for keeping accounting records for 5 years (Norwegian Bookkeeping Act § 13).

sections.title: Cookies
body: We use only necessary cookies: to keep you signed in, and to remember language and light or dark theme (for one year). We use no analytics or advertising cookies, so we do not ask for consent (Norwegian Electronic Communications Act § 3-15).

sections.title: Do you have to give us data?
body: A name and e-mail address are needed to create an account. Without them you cannot use MaskinGo.
We make no automated decisions about you and do no profiling.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can ask for access, correction, deletion, restriction and data portability, and you can object to processing based on legitimate interest. Write to {email} and we will reply within 30 days.
You can also complain to the Norwegian Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet, datatilsynet.no).

sections.title: Changes
body: If this policy changes significantly, we will tell users by e-mail or in the app before the change applies.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: These terms apply when a company and its users use MaskinGo.

sections.title: The parties
body: The service is provided by {company} (org. no. {orgNumber}), {address}. The agreement is made with the company that creates its firm in MaskinGo. The person who creates it confirms that they may bind the company.
MaskinGo is made for businesses and is not offered to consumers.

sections.title: Accounts and access
body: Each user has their own account and keeps the password secret. The company's owners and admins decide who gets access and which role, and are responsible for removing access when someone leaves.

sections.title: The company's responsibility
body: The company is responsible for the data it enters being lawful and correct.
The company tells its employees that working time, photos and signatures are recorded in MaskinGo, and does what the Norwegian Working Environment Act requires before such recording is used.
The service must not be used for unlawful purposes, to harm others, or to try to access other companies' data.

sections.title: Personal data
body: The company owns the data it enters. {company} processes it as a processor. The data processing agreement at maskingo.no/databehandleravtale is part of these terms.
How we process data about the users themselves is described in the privacy policy.

sections.title: Invoices
body: MaskinGo creates invoices from the data the company enters. An invoice is issued and sent only when a person presses the button. The company is responsible for the content, VAT and bookkeeping.

sections.title: Price
body: The prices are at maskingo.no/priser. The first 30 days are free, without a card. If the company wants to continue after that, it chooses a plan in the service and pays by card through Stripe. Nothing is charged until the company has chosen a plan itself. While payment is not switched on in the service, use is free.

sections.title: Rights to the service
body: MaskinGo, including its software, design and name, belongs to {company}. The company gets a non-exclusive right to use the service while the agreement lasts.

sections.title: Availability
body: MaskinGo is new and under active development. We do our best to keep the service available and secure, but cannot promise it will always be free of errors or interruptions.

We may suspend access temporarily in case of security threats or misuse. We are not liable for events outside our control, such as failures at power, network or subcontractor providers (force majeure).

sections.title: Liability
body: We are not liable for indirect losses, such as lost profit or lost data. Our total liability is limited to what the company has paid for the service in the last 12 months. The limit does not apply in case of gross negligence or intent.

sections.title: Ending the agreement
body: The company can stop using the service at any time by writing to {email}. We can end the agreement with 30 days' notice, or immediately in case of material breach.
After the agreement ends, the company can ask for its data for 90 days. After that we delete it. The company must itself keep the accounting records it is required to keep.

sections.title: Changes, governing law and disputes
body: We give at least 30 days' notice of significant changes to these terms. The agreement is governed by Norwegian law.
Disputes are first sought resolved by negotiation. Failing that, they are decided by the ordinary courts, with the venue of {company}'s home court.

dpa.title: Data processing agreement
dpa.lead: This agreement applies when {company} processes personal data on behalf of a company using MaskinGo. It meets the requirements of GDPR Article 28.

sections.title: Parties
body: The controller is the company that has created its firm in MaskinGo (“the company”). The processor is {company} (org. no. {orgNumber}), {address}.
The agreement is part of the terms of use and applies while the company uses the service, and after that until the data is deleted.

sections.title: Purpose and what is processed
body: Purpose: to provide MaskinGo, that is job planning, the driver app, time recording, the customer register and invoicing.
Data subjects: the company's employees and users, the company's customers and their contact persons, and people who may appear in photos.
Data: names, phone numbers, e-mail addresses, addresses, organisation numbers, jobs, working hours, photos, signatures and invoices.
The company must not enter special categories of personal data, such as health data, in MaskinGo.

sections.title: Instructions
body: We process the data only on the company's documented instructions. The instructions are the terms, this agreement and the choices the company makes in the app.
If we believe an instruction breaks data protection law, we tell the company.

sections.title: Confidentiality
body: Everyone working for us who has access to the data is bound by confidentiality.

sections.title: Security
body: We have technical and organisational measures under Article 32, including:
Encrypted transfer (HTTPS) and storage in the EU/EEA.
Each company's data is kept separate by access rules in the database (row level security), tested automatically with every change.
Roles that control what each user sees, and an extra sign-in step by e-mail for owners and admins.
Passwords are stored only as hashes, and uploaded files are kept in private storage without public links.

sections.title: Sub-processors
body: The company approves our use of these sub-processors: Supabase (database, sign-in and files, Stockholm), Vercel (runs the website, Stockholm) and Resend (e-mail, EU).
We impose the same obligations on them as in this agreement. We notify the company at least 30 days before we add or replace a sub-processor. The company may then object and end the agreement.

sections.title: Transfers outside the EU/EEA
body: The data is stored in the EU/EEA. The sub-processors are US companies and may in some cases access it from the US. Such transfers rely on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses or the EU–US Data Privacy Framework.

sections.title: Assistance
body: We help the company respond to data subject requests, with security, with data protection impact assessments and with prior consultation with Datatilsynet, as far as is reasonable for the service.
Requests from data subjects about the company's data are forwarded to the company.

sections.title: Breaches
body: If we become aware of a personal data breach, we notify the company without undue delay and at the latest within 48 hours. The notice describes what we know about the breach, its consequences and the measures taken.

sections.title: Audits
body: We give the company the information needed to show that this agreement is followed, and accept audits with reasonable notice. The company covers its own audit costs.

sections.title: Deletion and return
body: When the agreement ends, the company can ask for its data for 90 days. After that we delete it, also in the sub-processors' systems, unless the law requires it to be kept.
The company can export issued invoices itself in the app.

sections.title: Governing law
body: The agreement is governed by Norwegian law. If this agreement and the terms of use conflict, this agreement applies to the processing of personal data.

kranbil.metaTitle: Job system for crane trucks · MaskinGo
kranbil.metaDescription: Plan crane truck jobs, let the operator log time, photos and signature on the phone, and create the invoice from approved hours.
kranbil.summary: A calendar per crane truck, time and signature from the operator, and minimum time on the invoice.
kranbil.title: Crane truck jobs from booking to invoice
kranbil.lead: MaskinGo keeps the job, the operator, the hours and the invoice in one place, so the office no longer has to phone around and type in timesheets.
problems: Jobs come in by phone and text, and the overview lives in one person's head.
Hours and minimum time have to be collected from notes and messages before invoicing.
The customer asks how the job was done, and the photos are on someone's private phone.

points.title: A calendar per crane truck
points.body: See which crane trucks and operators are free, day by day or week by week. Lifting capacity in tm and payload are stored on each truck.

points.title: The operator taps on the phone
points.body: On the way, Arrived and Done. The job's time is recorded from the taps, and the office can correct it before the hours are approved.

points.title: Photos and the customer's signature
points.body: The operator takes photos of the job and lets the customer sign with a finger. Everything is saved on the job.

points.title: Minimum time and customer prices
points.body: Each crane truck has its hourly rate and minimum time, and a customer can have its own price. The invoice draft works it out for you.

faq.q: Does the operator have to install an app?
faq.a: No. MaskinGo opens in the phone's browser and can be added to the home screen. The operator only sees their own jobs.

faq.q: Can we have minimum time on the crane truck?
faq.a: Yes. You set the minimum billed hours per machine, for example 2. A shorter job is then invoiced as 2 hours.
No. The invoice is created as a draft from approved hours and is sent as a PDF by email only when someone in the office taps Send.

faq.q: Can the accountant get the figures?
faq.a: Yes. You download the invoices and credit notes for a period as one CSV file and all PDFs in one ZIP file. Sending as EHF comes later.

maskinentreprenor.metaDescription: Jobs, machines and operators in one calendar, time logging from the phone and invoices from approved hours. Made for Norwegian machine contractors.
maskinentreprenor.summary: Machines and operators in one calendar, timesheets for payroll and invoices from approved hours.
maskinentreprenor.title: One program for jobs, machines, hours and invoices
maskinentreprenor.lead: For contractors with excavators, wheel loaders or other construction machines: see who is where, get the hours in from the phone and invoice without typing them in again.
problems: Operators write their hours on paper or in texts, and they come in late.
It is hard to see which machines and operators are free next week.
Hours for payroll and hours for invoicing are kept in two places and do not always match.

points.title: Jobs and machines in the calendar
points.body: Each job has a customer, address, machine and operator. The calendar shows day and week, also per machine.

points.title: Time logging from the phone
points.body: The operator taps On the way, Arrived and Done on the job. The office sees the hours and can correct them before approval.

points.title: Timesheet for payroll
points.body: Each employee fills in and confirms the timesheet for the period. Overtime is split by your rules, and the accountant gets it as a PDF.

points.title: Invoices from approved hours
points.body: Sequential invoice numbers, a PDF and email to the customer when you tap Send. A mistake is corrected with a credit note.

faq.q: Does MaskinGo suit a small company?
faq.a: Yes. MaskinGo is made for small and medium contractors. You can start on your own and invite operators and the accountant when you are ready.
Administrator, dispatcher, driver and accountant each have their own role. An operator only sees their own jobs, and no company sees another company's data.
You choose after how many hours per day overtime starts and the extra percentage. You can also have a higher level, for example evenings and nights at +100 %.
On servers in the EU/EEA, in Stockholm. Read more in the privacy policy.

transport.metaTitle: Order system for transport and trucks · MaskinGo
transport.metaDescription: Assign truck and driver, get times, photos and the customer's signature from the driver's phone and create the invoice the same day.
transport.summary: Dispatching trucks and drivers, a digital work sheet and invoices the same day.
transport.title: Transport jobs without phone queues and paper slips
transport.lead: MaskinGo gives the dispatcher an overview of trucks and drivers, and the driver gets the job on the phone with customer and address.
problems: The dispatcher spends the day phoning drivers to hand out jobs.
Paper work sheets get lost or arrive weeks later.
The invoice waits because the hours have to be collected first.

points.title: Dispatching in the calendar
points.body: Assign truck and driver to the job and see who is free, day by day or per truck.

points.title: The job on the driver's phone
points.body: The driver only sees their own jobs with customer and address, and taps On the way, Arrived and Done.

points.title: Digital work sheet
points.body: Times, photos and the customer's signature are saved on the job, so the office has the paperwork the same day.

points.title: Invoice the same day
points.body: When the hours are approved, the invoice draft is created with the customer's prices. It is sent as a PDF by email when you tap Send.

faq.q: Can we invoice per trip or per tonne?
faq.a: Yes, as your own lines on the invoice with quantity, unit and price. The hours come from approved working time.

faq.q: Does it work for drivers who do not speak Norwegian?
faq.a: Yes. Each user chooses their own language: Norwegian, English or Lithuanian. Customer names and addresses are shown as they were entered.
No. Nothing is sent until someone in the office taps Send.
Not yet. Today the invoice is sent as a PDF by email. EHF is planned as a separate step.

timeforing.metaTitle: Time tracking for drivers and operators · MaskinGo
timeforing.metaDescription: Time tracking on the phone for drivers and machine operators: time from taps on the job, a payroll timesheet with overtime and a PDF for the accountant.
timeforing.summary: Time from the job, a payroll timesheet with overtime and a PDF for the accountant.
timeforing.badge: For drivers, operators and the office
timeforing.title: Time tracking you don't type in twice
timeforing.lead: The driver records time on the phone while the job is going on. The office approves the hours for the invoice, and each employee confirms their own payroll timesheet.
problems: Paper timesheets come in late, and some are always missing.
The office types the same hours in for payroll and for invoicing.
Overtime is worked out by hand and ends up different from person to person.

points.title: Time from taps on the job
points.body: The driver taps On the way, Arrived and Finished, and adds breaks. The job's time is recorded from the taps.

points.title: The office approves
points.body: The office sees the hours per job and can correct them with a reason before approving.

points.title: Payroll timesheet with overtime
points.body: Each employee fills in the days in the period and confirms. Overtime is split by hours per day or time of day, by your rules.

points.title: PDF for the accountant
points.body: When the timesheet is confirmed, it is locked and sent as a PDF to the accountant's email.

faq.q: Can a confirmed timesheet be changed?
faq.a: No. It is locked when confirmed. A wrong period can be deleted before confirming.
You choose after how many hours per day overtime starts and the extra percentage. You can also have a higher level or a time window, for example 19–06 +100 %.

faq.q: Does the accountant see every employee?
faq.a: Yes. The accountant sees every employee's timesheets per month, with the finished jobs in each period.
No. MaskinGo does not collect location. The time comes from the taps and what the employee enters.

faktura.metaTitle: Invoicing from hours for machine contractors · MaskinGo
faktura.metaDescription: Create invoice drafts from approved hours with the customer's prices and minimum time, add your own lines and send a PDF by email when you tap Send.
faktura.summary: Invoice drafts from approved hours, your own lines and a PDF by email.
faktura.badge: For the office and the accountant
faktura.title: From approved hours to an invoice the same day
faktura.lead: When the working time is approved, the invoice draft is ready with the customer's prices. You add what is missing and send it when you are happy.
problems: Hours have to be collected from notes and messages before the invoice can be made.
Minimum time and the customer's agreed price are easy to forget.
Days or weeks pass from the job being done to the invoice being sent.

points.title: Draft from approved time
points.body: The working time goes into the draft with the machine's hourly rate, the customer's own price and minimum time. A higher evening rate is included.

points.title: Your own lines
points.body: Add lines with quantity, unit and price, for example ferry, gravel, km or trips, with the right VAT rate.

points.title: Number and PDF
points.body: Sequential invoice numbers without gaps and a PDF with what the law requires. A sent invoice cannot be changed; mistakes are corrected with a credit note.

points.title: For the accountant
points.body: Download the invoices and credit notes for a period as one CSV file and all PDFs in one ZIP file.

faq.a: No. The invoice is sent as a PDF by email only when someone in the office taps Send.

faq.q: Can we invoice per tonne or per trip?
faq.a: Yes, as your own lines with quantity and unit. The hours come from approved working time.
Not yet. Today the invoice is sent as a PDF by email. EHF is planned as a separate step.
Invoices and PDFs are stored privately for at least 5 years, as the bookkeeping rules require.
